effect_prompt: The helicopter flies steadily through a cloudy sky with its rotor blades spinning, carrying the product suspended beneath it on thin cables that sway gently with natural motion. The camera stays locked in a fixed framing relative to the helicopter and the suspended product, while the clouds drift and the city skyline below continuously changes, passing beneath as if flying over different cityscapes. Soft atmospheric haze, photorealistic aerial cinematography, consistent composition throughout.
effect_prompt_note: Qua cac frame 18->120: truc thang + san pham treo day cap giu nguyen vi tri/ty le trong khung hinh (camera co dinh tuong doi so voi chu the, khong phai orbit/zoom), canh quat quay, day cap rung nhe tu nhien. Nen phia sau (may + duong chan troi thanh pho) lien tuc doi khac nhau qua tung frame (nhieu toa thap/landmark khac nhau xuat hien), giong hieu ung 'bay qua nhieu thanh pho'. O cac frame sau (~90-120) chat long trong chai co ve chuyen mau hai tong (nau/trang) nhung day la do nen phia sau thay doi phan chieu qua lop thuy tinh trong suot cua san pham (khong phai ban than san pham doi mau/chat lieu) nen KHONG dua chi tiet nay vao effect_prompt theo dung preserve_product_clause.
image_prompt: Replace the entire bottle in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.
image_prompt_note: Viet lai 2026-10 LAN 2 theo cong thuc da duoc NGUOI DUNG tu tay xac nhan hoat dong tren golden-fireworks (ca KHO NHAT, 5 lan thu truoc deu that bai): 'Replace the entire X in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.' Day la cau LENH TRUC TIEP (imperative 'Replace'), ngan gon, KHONG mo ta vi tri/scene/anh sang gi them -- bang chung cho thay day moi la yeu to quyet dinh (khong phai tranh phu dinh nhu ket luan LAN 1 truoc do, vi ban 'tich cuc' lan 1 van that bai tren chinh golden-fireworks). Tat ca 12 template dong loat doi sang cong thuc nay; CHUA retest het, uu tien retest cac ca TUNG THANH CONG o ban cu (helicopter-city-product, led-strips-colorful, smoky-pedestal) de dam bao khong lam hong cai dang chay tot.
